title: A space for art and peace in Nakuru
summary: At Nyayo Gardens, Peace in Colour Fest brought creative work and conversations about wellbeing into the same space.
body: On 27 September 2025, Peace in Colour Fest took place at Nyayo Gardens in Nakuru. Art for Children Foundation’s report names the Rotaract Club of Menengai among the event’s contributors.
Janet Nkirote, identified in the report as Menengai’s president at the time, moderated the peace panel. Discussions covered mental wellbeing, youth participation and reconciliation through art.
This was a joint activity. Its outcomes belong to the participating organisations and community, rather than any single club.
author: Rotaract Club of Menengai
approval: Existing public story; source attribution, date and venue corrected on 2026-10-12

title: Joining Nakuru’s city clean-up
summary: Menengai joined residents and local organisations in a clean-up reported by Nakuru County Government.
body: Nakuru County Government’s February 2024 report names the Rotaract Club of Menengai among the organisations participating in the city’s inaugural clean-up campaign.
The county described a joint effort with residents, businesses and public agencies. Menengai’s involvement is recorded as participation, rather than leadership of the full campaign.
The source was published on 9 February 2024. It does not establish a separate event date, so this archive uses the report’s publication date.

title: Sustainable enterprise across borders
summary: ZeroPlastic reports a sustainable entrepreneurship session involving Menengai’s Development Director, with collaborators in Sri Lanka and Uganda.
body: The organiser’s report records a 2 July 2026 online session on sustainable entrepreneurship and alternatives to plastic.
The Menengai representative is described by role, not name. Confirm the representative and club participation before publication.
author: Rotaract Club of Menengai

title: Joint medical camp at Kabati
summary: Rotaract Kenya names Menengai as a partner in the medical camp organised by Rotaract Naivasha at Kabati Dispensary.
body: Rotaract Kenya reports that the partnership served 541 residents at the 8 March 2025 medical camp. This is a shared project total, not Menengai’s individual impact.
